bundled_components.name: OpenSSL
bundled_components.observed: cryptography/hazmat/bindings/_rust.pyd embeds the version string 'OpenSSL 4.0.3 29 Sep 2026' and imports no OpenSSL DLL; the SBOM records build flags 'no-shared'.

notice.note: Neither the dist-info directory nor the package tree contains an OpenSSL license or copyright file. The SBOM names the upstream archive https://github.com/openssl/openssl/releases/download/openssl-4.0.3/openssl-4.0.3.tar.gz (SHA-256 325b5c806167c13b40b1ffeadfe0248197c00eccc4cf123ec1e28d2d2fd216d9); it was not retrieved offline, so no OpenSSL notice text is staged.

msvc.edition_specific_terms_status: Local Redist.txt links to Microsoft redistribution list; edition-specific license terms/conditions are not a grant verified by this inventory.

remaining_review: Current modified Digital/adapter/application source and exact build inputs must accompany any future source distribution; upstream revision alone omits local changes.
Mixed Digital GPLv3, EMF EPL-1.0 and ELK/Xtext EPL-2.0 composition is recorded without a compatibility verdict; local build/repro checks remain authorized.
XMLPull 1.1.3.1 exact sources jar is absent at Maven Central; official API public-domain declaration is collected, conformance-test LGPL code is not present in the binary.
ListenableFuture 9999 is an empty metadata-only placeholder with no source classes; its inherited Apache-2.0 POM is retained.

All nine shipped OSS CAD transitive runtime DLLs have exact Fedora package-member matches and corresponding notice mappings. Exact source RPMs are referenced, not included/rebuilt; RPM signatures were not independently verified. Readline package metadata and included COPYING disagree and both are preserved.

llama pinned CMake declares BoringSSL 0.20260903.0; canonical tag/commit/license evidence is collected and exact embedded BoringSSL notice preserved. Overridden upstream build flags and complete embedded browser/UI dependency attribution are not fully resolved by this audit.

CUDA 12.4.1 archived EULA and the hash-verified official cudart 12.4.127 archive/license are collected; cudart DLL equals the pinned llama member. cuBLAS 12.4.5.8 is identified by the official 12.4.1 redistribution index; full original cuBLAS archive equality was not downloaded/rechecked.
Rolling NVIDIA component-license URLs are supplemental current evidence, not substitutes for version-pinned archived terms.
Visual Studio local Redist inventory and Microsoft list are collected; publisher applicability of edition-specific terms is not decided here.
Standalone compiled library and source copyright notices must retain component-specific paths; the shaded jar single META-INF/LICENSE is insufficient.

cryptography 50.0.2 statically links OpenSSL 4.0.3 (wheel SBOM and embedded version string); the wheel ships no OpenSSL license or copyright file, and the upstream archive named by the SBOM was not retrieved, so no OpenSSL notice text is staged.

cryptography 50.0.2, pydantic_core 2.50.2 and rpds-py 2026.6.3 statically link Rust crates listed with license expressions in their shipped CycloneDX SBOMs (staged as provenance); individual crate license texts are not shipped in those wheels.
cffi 2.1.1's _cffi_backend imports no libffi DLL; the wheel ships no libffi license file or version identification.

pywin32 312 declares License: PSF while its license files are BSD-style (win32, com, pythonwin), LGPL-2.1 (adodbapi), Scintilla/SciTE, PSF (Pythonwin IDLE) and MIT (MAPIStubLibrary); the complete distribution is packaged and all eight files are preserved without a combined-license conclusion.
